scope: Selected generated C# 005010/006040 repeated body element values. Native reading and writing define the positive value and wire contract; generated admission is stricter for fixed values, component repetition and cardinality.

undeclared_repetition.message: Repeated X12 element values are outside the selected profile.

nonrepeating_in_repeating_segment.message: Repeated X12 element values are outside the selected profile.

repeated_scalar_composite_syntax.message: X12 scalar contains undeclared composite syntax.

repeated_invalid_int.message: X12 scalar has an invalid numeric representation.

output_item_repetition.message: X12 scalar contains an unrepresentable delimiter.

output_not_collection.message: X12 repeating fields require an ordered collection.

descriptor_legacy_repeating.message: 004010 elements cannot repeat or contain nested composites.

descriptor_fixed_repeating.message: Repeating X12 elements cannot carry fixed values or item cardinality.

fixed-repeating-scalar.reason: repeating X12 elements cannot carry fixed values

fixed-repeating-component.reason: repeating X12 elements cannot carry fixed values

repeating-envelope-element.reason: envelope elements require their exact width and String type

empty_semantics: Mirrors native format-edi: an absent element position reads as zero occurrences; a present empty element reads as one Null occurrence. Zero occurrences and a single trailing Null occurrence both write an empty, trimmed element.
ordering: Segments without a declared repeating element refuse repetition syntax during tokenization, before envelope/schema/mapping. Segments declaring one defer to their reader, which refuses repetition in each non-repeating element in element order.
